for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

translations.web: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.
translations.bsb: Without father or mother or genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, like the Son of God, he remains a priest for all time.
translations.kjv: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.
translations.asv: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like unto the Son of God), abideth a priest continually.
